name: 周报（入门示例）
description: 把一周随手记下的事情整理成周报：随手记（人）→ 草稿（模型）→ 检查（脚本）。 / Turn a week of rough notes into a weekly report: notes (person) → draft (model) → check (script).

name.description: 你的名字，写在周报标题里 / Your name, used in the report title

team.description: 周报写给谁看，例如：产品组、我的经理 / Who reads the report, e.g. the product team, my manager

language.description: 周报和检查结果的语言：zh 中文，en English / Language of the report and the check: zh or en

stages.name: 随手记
stages.description: 把这周做的事随手写下来，一行一件，不用整理。 / Jot down what you did this week, one thing per line, no polish needed.

executor.instructions: 把这周的事随手写进 notes.md，一行一件，不用整理。 / Jot this week's work into notes.md, one thing per line; no need to tidy it up.

stages.name: 周报草稿
stages.description: 模型把随手记整理成三段：本周完成、下周计划、需要帮助。 / A model turns the notes into three sections: done this week, next week, need help.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 检查周报有三个小节、没有留下待填的占位符、长度合适，结果写进 check.json。 / Checks the report has the three sections, no leftover placeholders and a sane length; writes check.json.
